subject: boxplots by date, with a 2-level variable dodged and colored-in... is this possible ?

messages.author: f5910785f085320f
messages.subject: boxplots by date, with a 2-level variable dodged and colored-in... is this possible ?
parts:
Hello ggplotters,

I have a graph with boxplots per day for a variable d1 (see attachment).

I would like to take the idea a step further though, in that I'd like to be able to have those boxplots per day per another variable named 'letter' that has 2 levels as well.
Ideally, these would be dodged and each given a distinct color (e.g. letter=='d' gets a color, letter=='e' gets the other color). So every day gets 2 boxplots, one for letter=='d' and another for letter=='e'.

The problem appears to be that I can't 'group=' by a vector (i.e. group=c(date,letter) would be nice to have ) .

Any help or suggestions appreciated (code and data are below... :)
(would also like to know the ggplot solution as well as the qplot solution...)

Regards and thanks in advance,
Avram


##R Code:
library(ggplot2)
library(pysch)
d<-read.clipboard.csv(header=TRUE) #just copy the data below to the clipboard first.
d$date <- as.Date(d$datestamp, '%M/%d/%y')

# This looks the way I want
qplot(data=d, x=date, y=d1, group=date, geom='boxplot')


# This doesn't work…
qplot(data=d, x=date, y=d1, group=date, geom='boxplot', colour=letter) # <-- how can I get this to work?

# Trying a different approach, the following replicates the first plot:
qplot(data=d, x=date, y=d1, group=date) + geom_boxplot()

The problem seems to be that I would like to group by 2 things, date and letter.

parts: > The problem appears to be that I can't 'group=' by a vector (i.e. group=c(date,letter) would be nice to have ) .

Yes, this is the problem, and happily there is also a solution:
qplot(data=d, x=date, y=d1, group=interaction(date, letter),
geom='boxplot', colour=letter)

Charlotte
